name: primitives-headless-switch

frames.best_why: One switch is off and three are on, showing both track states plus the themed row with its icons.

tagline: Settings rows whose small switches slide and stretch when tapped.
summary: A Connections card listing four options, each with a small pill switch; tapping one slides the thumb across and the thumb widens while held, with sun and moon icons on the theme row.
appearance: A dark rounded card headed Connections with grey helper text and four rows, each with a bold title, a small grey description and a pill switch on the right. Switches are grey when off and white when on.
behaviour: Clicking a switch moves its white thumb to the other end with a spring, and the thumb stretches wider while held before settling back. The theme switch swaps a moon on the left for a sun on the right.
demo_content: Rows for Airplane mode, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Theme with short captions about wireless radios and networks.
search_phrases: on off toggle for settings rows
toggles with sun and moon icons
ios style toggle in a list
use_when: A settings list needs compact on/off toggles with a clear checked state.
avoid_when: It is renderless, so track, thumb and icon styling must all come from your own classes.
customise: Children hold the thumb and optional icons; set defaultChecked or a controlled value plus a thumb pressedAnimation, while track and thumb styles come from your classes.
weight_why: Four small buttons with a moving thumb; nothing runs when idle.

a11y.note: The switches carry no accessible name tied to their row titles, so screen readers announce a generic switch, and focus styling is absent.

issues: Off switches are a faint grey track on the dark card, so their state is easy to miss.
The switches are unlabelled, so their row titles are not announced with them.
polish_why: Tidy settings rows and a tactile stretch; faint off states are the weak point.
